packageRules.description: slsa-verifier verifies the generator's ref, so it is called by its vX.Y.Z tag, never by a SHA.
Claude Code ships most days; take its releases once a week.

customManagers.description: A version on the line below a '# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name>' comment.

The claude-code-version default the action reference states, so the page moves with action.yml: the first pattern takes a line from the input's name on, the second the backticked version in it. The minimum the page names is not backticked and stays.
